pages.title: Beyond Netherite
pages.text: Improve your own equipment through the available Invulnerite smithing upgrade

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Defeating the underground lair guardian releases its tangled Invulnerite ore. Craft nine nuggets into one chunk. Make the Invulnerite template with a Netherite template, a blank template and one nugget, then use it with Netherite equipment and an Invulnerite chunk
